card.title: Vice President, Plant Operations & CI (Engineered Equipment)
card.description:
**Make a modern manufacturing hub from a blank canvas**
-------------------------------------------------------

Our mission in Temple, Texas is ambitious: transform **40,000 sq. ft.** of open space into a flagship, high-mix custom manufacturing operation. We’re seeking a Vice President to serve as General Manager—an owner-operator who will design the system, assemble the team, and deliver results.

### **Your Mandate**

* Architect and launch a state-of-the-art facility
* Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing team of **50+ employees**
* Direct choices on equipment, automation, layout, workflow, and capital allocation
* Install an operating model with clear KPIs, accountability, and a relentless CI mindset
* Own plant-level financial performance and operating results

### **Impact in Your First 12 Months**

* Facility commissioned and producing to plan in a high-mix environment
* Core leadership team staffed; hourly pipeline established and trained
* Baseline metrics for safety, quality, delivery, and cost tracking against targets
* Lean practices embedded; bottlenecks identified and constraint management in motion
* Partnership cadence with the President on capital, performance, strategy, and growth

### **What You Bring**

* **15+ years** in progressive manufacturing/operations leadership
* Direct experience launching, relocating, or substantially expanding a manufacturing operation
* Technical depth in **sheet metal fabrication, metal fabrication, welding, industrial equipment, HVAC/ductwork, process equipment, or engineered products**
* Proven ability to recruit and scale both salaried and hourly teams
* Fluency in **lean manufacturing, production planning, quality systems, constraint management, and continuous improvement**
* A leadership ethos of **high standards, low ego, and genuine respect for people**

### **The Environment**

* High-mix custom manufacturing
* Strong customer demand and executive sponsorship
* Significant long-term growth ahead

### **Rewards**

Competitive executive compensation with performance-based incentives and comprehensive benefits.

### **Proficiencies**

* Leadership / People Management
* Industrial and Manufacturing Engineering
* Continuous Improvement
* Manufacturing Instruction (MI)
* Supervisory Experience
* Glass Fabrication
* Coaching and Mentoring Experience
* Operational Risk Management
* Workplace Safety & EHS Management
* Metal Casting Experience

### **Culture**

We build with rigor, humility, and respect—giving you the authority to shape the facility, the team, and the way the operation runs.

card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
The Plant Manager will work closely with other departments and managers to ensure
 
all in-process production metrics as deliverables are being met. This team member will be focused
 
on overall safety, production deliverables and continuous improvement as we continue our growth. 
Job Duties & Responsibilities: 

* Establishing and maintaining production and shipping schedules and ensuring that quality

product is consistently delivered to customers on time and within budget for labor hours,
 
machine hours and material costs 

* Managing production operations such that equipment and employee resources are

utilized efficiently, productivity is high and product quality requirements are met and
 
exceeded 

* Ensuring that process and equipment capabilities meet or exceed company and industry

standards and requirements; implementing operations-related initiatives that result in
 
increased efficiency, improved productivity and reduced job-related costs 

* Full participation in weekly production meetings and daily work-related meetings is

expected 

* Maintaining company policies and procedures with respect to production, materials, and

equipment-related activities, ensuring that employees report labor hours, machine hours,
 
material usage and activities in accordance with company policies and procedures and
 
within the current operations management and control systems 

* Implementing operations and function-related budgeting goals and objectives;

establishing benchmarks for monthly, quarterly, and annual case production and
 
shipments, material receipts, production work-in-process completed and inventory levels
 
within the Plant Level of Operations 

* Preparing and presenting to Director of Operations, the weekly executive summary that

includes production, purchasing, shipping, receiving and inventory numbers as part of the
 
system of infernal checks and balances 

* Recruiting, selecting, training, motivating and evaluating all operations employees in

accordance with company human relations policies and procedures 

* Helping to build and manage within a team-based production environment and developing

and maintaining good working relationships between production, materials, and
 
equipment maintenance 

* Interfacing between the employees in the department and the Director of Operations, the

Executive Vice-President and President of the Company and supporting company policies,
 
goals, objectives, and initiatives 

* Ensuring that all product produced meets quality requirements in accordance with

company policy, procedures and requirements and in accordance with industry standards 

* Keeping the Management abreast of successes, progress and potential problems and

offering appropriate solutions for those problems 

* Simultaneously handling, prioritizing and resolving problems effectively
* Ensuring that shipment deadlines and budget and profitability objectives (i.e. gross margin

and operating profit) are met and exceeded on a quarterly and annual basis as established
 
by Director of Operations 

* Ensuring achievement of production metrics and shipment objectives, including labor

hours per case, machine time per case, quality and cost per case; ensure that labor and
 
machine efficiency is within company guidelines; ensuring that periodic maintenance,
 
repair, rework hours and waste are within company guidelines 

* Ascertaining that purchasing, production support, shipping and receiving performance

metrics and objectives and inventory units and balance objectives are achieved or
 
exceeded on a quarterly and annual basis while ensuring on-time delivery of quality
 
product to customers at budgeted cost per case 

* Ensuring quality products are produced and quality relationships are established and

maintained between production, materials and equipment maintenance personnel, with
 
engineering and sales, customers, subcontractors and others in the area and in the
 
industry 

* Ensuring customer complaints are fewer and of less seriousness than company targets and

objectives 

* Ensuring that reporting and supporting documentation is completed on time and in

accordance with company procedures 

* Achieving Company goals to produce quality product on time and within budget hours are

supported in theory and followed in practice

Job Qualifications:
 

* 5+ year’s relevant industrial and manufacturing experience
* Associates degree in industrial, mechanical, or electrical engineering or equivalent

experience. Manufacturing engineering and operations management an added plus 

* Relevant and current technical knowledge concerning products, materials and equipment
* Knowledge, skills and ability to understand and manage food processing activities and

production lines to provide expertise and technical support to all plant employees, to
 
make equipment, production and materials related decisions 

* Ability to maintain production planning and scheduling, shop loading, expediting and

dispatching, purchasing, shipping and receiving and inventory control functions using
 
manufacturing systems in place 

* Ability to lead and motivate teams to produce quality product, on schedule and within

budget and participate in and facilitate operations-related team meetings 

* Outstanding communication skills with proven ability to successfully lead and develop a

team 

* Excellent team leadership skills and an ability to set goals, accomplish objectives, coach

and counsel while adding to the organizational climate and culture 

* Personal characteristics reflective of a fast paced industry: high energy, self-motivated,

positive attitude, service oriented, flexible, ethical, loyal and with high degree of integrity 

* Business maturity, team orientation and proven ability to positively influence change and

ensure business discipline through periods of growth while simultaneously protecting the
 
company’s operating principles and underlying entrepreneurial culture 

* Demonstrated good judgment in prioritizing, expediting, investigating and resolving

problems and issues and fosters harmonious relations with other company employees
 
while meeting and exceeding customer requirements 

* Respect for the confidentiality of company, customer, and employee information

Competencies: 

* Managing People - Includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating and process

improvement; Takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self-available to staff;
 
Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages
 
growth; Solicits and applies customer feedback (internal and external); Fosters quality focus
 
in others; Improves processes, products, and services.; Continually works to improve
 
supervisory skills. 

* Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks

correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values; Benefits organization
 
through outside activities; Supports affirmative action and respects diversity. 

* Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and

analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem
 
solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics. 

* Quality Management - Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Demonstrates

accuracy and thoroughness. 

* Safety and Security - Observes safety and security procedures; Determines appropriate

action beyond guidelines; Reports potentially unsafe conditions; Uses equipment and
 
materials properly. 

* Strategic Thinking - Develops strategies to achieve organizational goals; Understands

organization's strengths & weaknesses; Analyzes market and competition; Identifies
 
external threats and opportunities; Adapts strategy to changing conditions. 

* Technical Skills - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; Pursues training and

development opportunities; Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; Shares
 
expertise with others. 
PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT: Work is performed indoors in a manufacturing 
setting with regular exposure to cold, heat, noise, and moving machines and equipment. Must be
 
able to lift to 50 lbs, push and pull up to 40 lbs, lift, stand and carry consistently, have proper hearing,
 
vision and speech capabilities. Can wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) (Hearing protection,
 
safety glasses, goggles, or shields). 
The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of
 
this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or physical
 
requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign
 
duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Reasonable accommodations may be made to
 
enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

card.title: Senior Manager, Quality Investigation/CAPA
card.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

The Senior Manager, Quality Investigation/CAPA leads the US Pharmaceutical Distribution team responsible for quality investigations, temperature excursions, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and suspect or illegitimate product reviews. The manager provides day-to-day direction, technical guidance, and coaching to help the team complete accurate, timely, and risk-based work. This role also supports quality systems, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement across the distribution network.

 
 

**Compensation: The salary for this role is targeted between $140,000 and $145,000 yearly with an annual bonus opportunity.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leads and develops the Investigation/CAPA team. Sets priorities, assigns work, monitors workload and performance, and provides regular coaching and feedback. Ensures investigations, CAPAs, regulatory notifications, trend reports, and self-audits are completed on time and meet quality requirements.
* Keeps Investigation/CAPA processes current and practical. Updates procedures, work instructions, training, and tools so the Quality team and distribution centers follow a consistent approach.
* Provides oversight for complex product quality investigations, temperature excursions, complaints, quarantines, critical events, and suspect or illegitimate product cases. Guides investigation strategy, root cause analysis, risk assessment, escalation, product disposition support, and final conclusions.
* Implements approved improvements to quality systems and processes, including electronic quality management system updates and standardized tools. Works with affected USPD teams and locations to put changes into practice.
* Tracks investigation and CAPA performance, including aging, timeliness, effectiveness, and recurring trends. Shares findings with leadership and adjusts priorities or starts corrective action when needed.
* Ensures the team consistently applies FDA, DEA, Drug Supply Chain Security Act, Good Distribution Practice, current Good Manufacturing Practice, data integrity, and internal quality requirements. Partners with Enterprise Quality, Operations, distribution centers, Transportation, Recall, Global Security, and other groups to resolve issues.
* Represents Quality on audits, inspections, projects, and cross-functional initiatives. Presents technical information clearly, coordinates assigned work, and follows through on commitments.
* Manages the team’s approved operating expenses, including applicable electronic quality management system costs.
 

 

**Minimum Requirement**

Degree or equivalent experience. Typically requires 9+ years of professional experience and 1+ years of supervisory and/or management experience.

 
 

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field.

 
 

**Critical Skills**

* At least 9 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical quality, investigations, CAPA, regulated distribution, cold-chain operations, quality systems, or another highly regulated environment.
* At least 1 year of direct people-management or supervisory experience, with demonstrated ability to set expectations, manage performance, coach employees, and build team capability.
* Experience leading complex investigations and CAPAs, assessing risk, resolving quality or compliance issues, and driving timely, effective outcomes.
* Working knowledge of applicable FDA requirements, including 21 CFR and the Drug Supply Chain Security Act, as well as applicable DEA requirements and the Controlled Substances Act.
* Knowledge of Good Distribution Practice and current Good Manufacturing Practice principles, root cause analysis, quality risk management, data integrity, and audit or inspection readiness.
* Experience implementing, validating, or migrating electronic quality management systems.
* Strong technical writing, analytical, project leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, use sound judgment, and work effectively across a large, matrixed organization.
* Knowledge of wholesale pharmaceutical distribution or pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and quality data analysis tools.
* Ability to work remotely while maintaining regular collaboration with distribution centers, Central Fill Pharmacy locations, and corporate partners.
* Ability to travel domestically, including occasional overnight travel, approximately 10% to 15%.
* Ability to work from home within approximately a two-hour drive of a USPD distribution center.

This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. card.title: Director of Quality
card.description:
Responsible to manage, promote, and continuously maintain a compliant quality management system by effectively managing the quality department that consist of validation, quality inspection, document control, change control, customer complaints, metrology, CAPA management, nonconforming product, calibration, receiving inspection and product release activities. As a quality manager you will ensure that the manufacturing site meets and applies the Global Quality Policies and Guidelines relating to, ISO 9001 & 13485 standards, FDA 21 CFR 820 regulations, customer requirements and comply with necessary local and international regulations.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities****:**

* Responsible for , leading developing, implementing and manage an effective quality management systems that supports the company-wide quality policy, ISO 9000, ISO 13485 and FDA 21 CFR 820 regulations for medical devices with a continuous improvement programs.
* Lead, develop, implement and maintain quality systems for controlling product quality using process capability, inspection, auditing and statistical analysis.
* Lead, develop, implement and maintain an effective quality system for preventing nonconforming product and/or its recurrence using quality planning, material review, corrective action and quality reporting.
* Responsible for selection, interviewing and onboarding of new hires and develop a relevant training program and plan for all site personnel.
* Responsible for leading, driving and enforcing quality programs in collaboration with manufacturing team.
* Resolve customer concerns, complaints and provide feedback on quality issues.
* Analyze daily and monthly quality reports and develop tests to improve product quality.
* Manage day to day department activities.
* Support company quality policy and objectives.
* Ensure products produced meets customer expectations (approve quality specifications) and regulatory requirements
* Lead customer audits, ISO audits and Internal audits
* Achieve financial objectives (maintain department salaries within budget, prepare the Quality budget, schedule the expenditures)
* Follow and report of the site quality performances from a quality standpoint and ensure alignment with Business Unit and manage continuous improvement for product quality
* In cooperation with the Sites Quality Coordinator, develop and implement Quality Objectives in line with objectives of the business unit
* Lead and influence a quality mindset to quality and operations to maintain, improving and maintaining quality system requirements.
* Continually improve quality through analyzing, identifying, and eliminating root causes. Such improvements include reducing defects, decreasing scrap, reducing waste, and improving outputs.
* Apply and evaluate testing and inspection methods; including the identification of requirements for improvements.
* Develop and implement quality cost reduction concepts and techniques.
* Manage department resources, including work assignments, training, cross training, personnel issues, hiring decisions, performance appraisals, motivation, efficiency, capacity and accuracy of work.
* Ensure shift-to-shift communication.
* Provide a safe work environment and resolve any safety issues that arise.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

**Core Competencies:**

* Facilitation
* Conflict Management
* Fostering Learning
* Information Gathering & Processing
* Interactive Communication
* Partnering
* Relationship Building
* Research
* Teamwork
* Writing Skills
* Attention to detail
* Adaptability
* Concern for Safety
* Proactive and self-motivated
* Strong time management with priority setting skills
* Client focused

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Expert knowledge and interpretation of ISO 13485, ISO 9000 standards, 21 CFR 820 and cGMP compliance.
* Ability to lead, implement quality management systems as applicable to ISO and 21 CFR regulations.
* Demonstrate understanding of industry standard validation tools and techniques.
* Demonstrated ability of metrology and basic inspection tools, metrology and injection molding workmanship standards.
* Ability to develop/conduct quality related training programs.
* Effectively communicate in both verbal and written.
* Good organizational skills.
* Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal).
* Fluency in Spanish a plus.
* Understanding and use of metrology equipment.
* Ability to read drawings and good understanding of geometric tolerancing.
* Knowledge of processing engineering polymers is a plus.
* Exceptional leadership skills which include ability to prioritize, lead, direct, train, and motivate staff.
* Ability to influence peers.
* Excellent planning and organizational skills.
* Good analytical, problem-solving and math skills. Six Sigma and Lean knowledge a plus.
* Understanding and use of sampling plans, Gauge R&R, statistical techniques and SPC.
* Ability to use personal computer and Windows-based software (Outlook, Word and Excel preferred). Use of PC-DMIS metrology software, IQMS manufacturing software and Minitab a plus.

**Education and/or Experience**:

* Bachelor’s degree desirable, four-year college degree (preferably in a sciences chemical, pharmacy, plastics or engineering field) or equivalent combined college/work experience.
* At least 5 years of leading and implementing quality systems in a pharmaceutical or medical device environment
* Manufacturing experience in injection molding plastics industry (or equivalent industry) is a plus.

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
**Director of Operations**

**Discovery Center Collective: Don Harrington Discovery Center & Wildcat Bluff Nature Center**

**Job Title**: Director of Operations 
**Status:** Full-Time, Exempt

**Reports to:** Chief Executive Officer

**Position Overview**

The Director of Operations leads the systems, people, facilities and daily operations that create a safe, engaging, and well-run experience across Discovery Center Collective. This position oversees internal systems, physical facilities and grounds, and aspects of exhibits and visitor experience, while providing leadership for operational systems, purchasing, vendor coordination, and processes that support efficient and consistent operations across both locations.

As a member of the leadership team, the Director balances organizational planning with hands-on operational leadership, working closely with department leaders to ensure DCC's programs, services, facilities, and operational resources function effectively.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

**Operational Systems & Process Management**

* Oversee operational systems supporting admissions, memberships, ticketing, reservations, rentals, and other visitor-facing transactions.
* Serve as the functional owner for designated operational platforms, including Altru museum management software, other museum and booking platforms, and those implemented in future.
* Establish and maintain consistent operational procedures, workflows, documentation, and training standards.
* Coordinate system configuration, troubleshooting, updates, and vendor support.
* Ensure appropriate system access and training for employees using operational platforms.
* Monitor operational reporting and transaction data to support decision-making and process improvements.
* Collaborate with CEO and other team members ensure appropriate financial controls, reconciliation, and accurate transaction reporting.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce duplication, and improve system effectiveness.

 

**Purchasing, Inventory & Vendor Management**

* Oversee operational purchasing and procurement processes across DCC.
* Coordinate purchasing needs, vendor relationships, and inventory management for assigned operational areas.
* Establish consistent purchasing procedures and approval workflows in partnership with CEO and other team members.
* Evaluate vendor services, pricing, contracts, and purchasing practices to support operational efficiency and responsible resource management.
* Coordinate purchasing and inventory processes supporting retail, concessions, exhibits, facilities, and other operational functions.
* Ensure purchases align with approved budgets, organizational priorities, and established financial controls.

 

**Facilities Management and Exhibits Support**

* Ensure facilities, grounds, exhibits, and public spaces are safe, functional, clean, and appropriately maintained.
* Support the installation, maintenance, functionality, and improvement of exhibits and interactive environments.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance schedules and priorities for facilities, exhibits, and equipment.
* Support appropriate standards for animal care, safety, and habitat standards through repairs and maintenance of animal exhibits and experiences.
* Coordinate repairs, inspections, contractors, and maintenance vendors.
* Identify and prioritize facility improvements, equipment needs, and capital projects.
* Oversee custodial operations and facility readiness.
* Coordinate with Education Department as needed to ensure exhibits and facilities support intended learning outcomes.
* Support as liaison for vendors such as insurance companies, OSHA, city and state as needed.
* Support organizational emergency preparedness, physical safety procedures, and facility-related risk management.

 

**Technology & Operational Infrastructure**

* Coordinate technology needs related to operational systems, facilities, equipment, and visitor-facing services.
* Serve as a liaison with technology vendors and external IT providers for assigned operational platforms.
* Support implementation, training, and ongoing effectiveness of approved operational technology.
* Partner with the CEO and other staff regarding financial systems, payroll systems, access controls, and administrative technology needs.
* Coordinate with qualified external providers on technical issues, cybersecurity, and infrastructure concerns.

 

**Visitor Experience Support**

* Provide leadership and support for daily operations across both DCC locations.
* Establish and maintain operational standards that support safety, efficiency, consistency, and a positive guest experience.
* Work with and support the Manager of Visitor Experience, ensuring appropriate staffing, training, service standards, and operational accountability.
* Support admissions, memberships, retail, concessions, rentals, and other visitor-facing operations through the Manager of Visitor Experience.
* Evaluate operational performance, guest feedback, and organizational needs to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate operational readiness for programs, special events, rentals, and other organizational activities.
* Support resolution of significant operational challenges and escalated guest concerns.

 

**Department Leadership & Organizational Collaboration**

* Lead and develop assigned employees and functional teams, including facilities and grounds, operational support staff, and others.
* Establish department goals, priorities, performance expectations, and accountability.
* Partner with Fractional HR regarding hiring, employee relations, performance management, training, and workforce planning.
* Develop and manage operational budgets in collaboration with the CEO and other team members.
* Identify staffing, equipment, technology, facility, and capital needs and make appropriate recommendations.
* Collaborate with Education, Marketing & Advancement, and other departments to support programs, events, organizational initiatives, and revenue-generating activities.
* Participate as an active member of the organizational leadership team.
* Communicate operational priorities, challenges, risks, and opportunities to the CEO.

 

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, operations management, hospitality, museum studies, nonprofit management, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in operations, facilities, visitor attractions, hospitality, museums, or a related environment preferred.
* Demonstrated experience supervising employees and managing through other supervisors or managers.
* Experience overseeing multiple operational functions, systems, vendors, or facilities.
* Strong understanding of operational processes, purchasing, inventory, and technology-supported workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, projects, competing priorities, and operational challenges.
* Experience with public-facing facilities, exhibits, or animal care environments is beneficial; expertise in every functional area is not required.
* Ability to work within a high-energy, passionate and collaborative team environment.
* Strong leadership, communication, judgment, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

 

**Skills & Competencies**

* Operational leadership
* Team development; guest experience
* Facilities and exhibit management
* Purchasing and vendor coordination
* Systems administration
* Process improvement
* Project management
* Budgeting
* Safety and risk awareness
* Prioritization
* Cross-functional collaboration

 

**Physical & Work Environment Requirements**

* Work is performed across DCC facilities, including public spaces, offices, exhibit areas, outdoor environments, and operational areas.
* Requires regular walking, standing, and movement throughout facilities, with occasional bending, reaching, and lifting associated with operational oversight.
* Ability to work at a computer and use standard office and operational technology.
* Occasional evenings, weekends, and schedule adjustments may be required for events, emergencies, and organizational needs.
* Work may involve exposure to outdoor conditions, animals, equipment, and active public environments.

card.title: Head of Product Operations
card.description:
### **YOUR MISSION**

Make Nulogy's Product and Engineering organization run like a well-oiled machine, and make sure the rest of the company can see, trust, and act on what it builds. As a member of the Product Leadership Team, you will own the operating system behind how we plan, deliver, measure, and launch product. You will connect the voice of our customers and go-to-market teams to the roadmap, give leadership clear visibility into delivery and outcomes, and ensure every release lands with customers and colleagues who know exactly what changed and why it matters.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Keep the trains running on time across Product and Engineering.** Build and run an effective operating rhythm, including planning, roadmap reviews, and delivery check-ins, with one trusted view of every initiative's timeline, dependencies, and risks.
* **Raise delivery predictability.** Support and coach Product Managers and Engineering Managers to plan realistically, spot delivery risk early, and act on it.
* **Close the loop between go-to-market and Product.** Maintain a living log of product needs from new-logo and existing-customer opportunities, tied to pipeline and ARR, and track friction points across the customer lifecycle with Customer Success and Professional Services.
* **Put the right data behind product decisions.** Centralize data from our product, delivery, customer, and revenue systems so PMs and leaders can answer key questions without hunting for numbers.
* **Build trust through KPIs, reporting, and transparency.** Define core product and delivery KPIs with the Product Leadership Team, and own the dashboards and reporting that feed executive, board, and all-hands updates.
* **Align the organization around what we're building.** Make sure Product and Engineering plans are understood across GTM, Customer Success, Services, Finance, and leadership, and that every release lands through release notes, customer communications, and internal enablement.
* **Be present with customers.** Join customer visits, calls, and reviews, and bring what you hear back into planning.
* **Be a right hand to the CPO.** Drive the day-to-day of the product organization, prepare executive communication briefs, and lead special projects as they come up.

**EXPERIENCE & SKILL REQUIREMENTS**

* 8+ years in product operations, program or delivery management, product management, business operations, or a chief-of-staff-style role at a B2B SaaS company, including 3+ years working across Product and Engineering.
* A track record of running an operating rhythm and tracking delivery across multiple product and engineering teams, including coaching teams to improve predictability.
* Hands-on experience centralizing data from multiple systems into a single view
* Experience building KPIs and reporting that executives relied on for decisions.
* Strong executive communication: you've written leadership briefs, executive updates, or board materials.
* Comfortable working directly with customers, including on-site visits.
* Experience as a trusted partner to a senior leader, owning day-to-day operations and special projects.
* Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.
* AI-first operating habits: you use AI tools daily in your own work.
* Able to travel as needed for customer visits and team offsites approximately 1-2x a quarter
* Experience in enterprise SaaS serving supply chain, manufacturing, or logistics.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as Jira and Confluence, Pendo, Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience running release communications or launch programs for customers and internal teams.
* Experience measuring product adoption and usage.
* A background as a Product Manager, Engineering Manager, Program Manager, or Chief of Staff to a product or engineering leader.

**COMPANY OVERVIEW** 
 
Nulogy is a manufacturing technology company driven by a vision to make life better for the people who plan, produce, and deliver the products we use every day. 
Nulogy’s Manufacturing Operating System helps manufacturers and packagers automate every stage of the production process—from inventory to quality—which reduces operating costs, increases efficiency, and boosts customer satisfaction. Hundreds of manufacturing sites around the world are powered by Nulogy, and our software also runs in the networks of world-leading brands such as Colgate-Palmolive, L’Oréal, and Procter & Gamble. 
 
Nulogy has grown rapidly over the last decade, and we are proud to be recognized with a number of awards including: Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers, Food Logistics Top 100 Software Provider, and Canada's Most Admired Corporate Culture. Nulogy has also received multiple awards for company culture, the most recent being one of Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers for 2024, Great Place to Work 2025 & Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2025. 
 
By joining Nulogy, you’ll become part of a fantastic culture of capable and motivated individuals. You’ll also join a team that is solving challenging problems every day with the potential to make a global impact. 
 
**OUR VALUES** 
**1. We put people first** 
We lead with genuine care, build strong relationships, and create space for people to grow. 
**2. We rewrite the playbook** 
We don’t wait for perfect conditions. We move, deliver, and refine, solving problems creatively as we go. 
**3. We learn up** 
We stay curious, learn from the people and experiences around us, and keep looking ahead. 
**4. We take the hot potato!** 
When something goes wrong, we don’t pass the problem along. We take ownership and work together to solve it. 
**5. We ring the bell together** 
We celebrate success as a team and recognize the people who helped make it happen. 
 
**WHY NULOGY** 
We’re solving problems that no one has been able to solve before. This is an opportunity to join a team that is transforming the way that supply chains are structured. 
 
Competitive benefits package: Group benefit plans including health, dental, and vision that start on day one—benefit premiums are fully paid by the employer; Parental leave: 100% top-up for 15 weeks for any parent of biological or adopted children; Flexible paid vacation policy; RRSP Matching Program, 401K program. 
 
**FULLY REMOTE** 
Everyone is set up with the tools and resources required to stay connected and help employees do their best work. 
 
*Nulogy embraces diversity, and we recognize the need for teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We encourage everyone to apply.*

card.description:
Description:

**Spartronics, LLC**

**Career Opportunity: Site Director of Operations**

**Location:** North Logan, Utah 
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Salaried | Exempt 
**Work Arrangement:** On-Site 
**Schedule:** Full-Time, Monday–Friday 
**Reports To:** Vice President of Operations – West / Logan Site Leader

**Who We Are**

At **Spartronics**, we build more than electronics. We build the technology that powers critical applications across aerospace and defense, medical devices, life sciences, and industrial markets.

As a leading provider of electronic manufacturing services (EMS), Spartronics specializes in complex, high-reliability products, including printed circuit board assemblies (PCBA), electromechanical assemblies, integrated systems, and complete product manufacturing solutions.

**Career Opportunity: Director of Operations**

Spartronics is seeking an experienced **Director of Operations** to lead manufacturing operations and drive operational excellence at our North Logan, Utah facility.

This senior leadership position is responsible for the overall performance, execution, and continuous improvement of the site's operational functions, including **Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Materials Planning**, while providing indirect operational oversight and cross-functional partnership with Program Management.

Reporting to the Vice President of Operations – West / Logan Site Leader, the Director of Operations will establish operational priorities, develop high-performing teams, optimize manufacturing processes, and ensure the organization consistently achieves its safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and profitability objectives.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader with strong business acumen, experience managing multiple operational disciplines, and a proven ability to drive results in complex, highly regulated manufacturing environments.

**What You Will Do**

* Provide strategic direction and operational leadership for the facility, translating organizational objectives into actionable plans, performance expectations, and measurable results.
* Direct Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Materials Planning functions, ensuring effective coordination, accountability, and alignment with site and corporate objectives.
* Provide indirect operational oversight and strategic partnership to Program Management, ensuring alignment between customer requirements, program execution, operational capacity and business objectives.
* Direct manufacturing operations, production planning, capacity management, and resource allocation, balancing changing customer demand, product complexity, and manufacturing constraints to achieve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity objectives.
* Establish operational priorities, evaluate performance against key metrics, and implement corrective actions to address performance gaps and emerging risks.
* Provide leadership and oversight of engineering activities, including process optimization, technical problem resolution, manufacturing readiness, new product introduction, and product transfers.
* Ensure the effectiveness of quality management systems, regulatory compliance, product conformity, and corrective and preventive action processes while preserving Quality's independent authority over product acceptance and compliance decisions.
* Oversee supply chain and materials planning activities, including procurement, supplier performance, inventory management, material availability, and production support.
* Partner with Program Management and other customer-facing functions to address delivery commitments, operational concerns, customer escalations, and changing business requirements.
* Develop operational budgets, resource plans, capital expenditure priorities, and cost improvement initiatives in collaboration with Finance, supporting achievement of site financial objectives and profitability targets..
* Evaluate operational and financial performance, identifying opportunities to improve profitability, reduce waste, control costs, and optimize resource utilization.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and other structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Ensure manufacturing processes, product traceability, configuration and change control, and supporting documentation comply with applicable customer, industry, regulatory, and company requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure operational compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety requirements.
* Establish and maintain structured operational performance management systems, including KPI reviews, cross-functional accountability, issue escalation, and corrective action follow-through to support timely, data-driven decision-making.
* Build, coach, and develop operational leadership teams, establishing clear performance expectations, succession plans, and workforce competency and development priorities.
* Collaborate with Human Resources on workforce planning, staffing requirements, employee performance, organizational development, and retention strategies.
* Coordinate with Facilities, Security, and other support functions to address infrastructure needs, operational continuity, physical security requirements, and business risks.
* Evaluate manufacturing capacity, technology, equipment, and infrastructure needs to support business growth, operational scalability, and capital investment decisions.
* Identify and mitigate operational risks associated with production disruptions, supplier constraints, quality concerns, regulatory requirements, and customer commitments.
* Represent site operations in corporate leadership discussions, customer interactions, audits, and strategic planning activities, communicating performance, priorities, and resource requirements.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support organizational objectives.

Requirements:

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing operations, including at least five years in a senior leadership capacity overseeing multiple operational functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex manufacturing operations with accountability for production, engineering, quality, supply chain, and cross-functional business objectives.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, production planning, capacity management, materials management, and operational performance improvement.
* Demonstrated knowledge of manufacturing engineering principles, process controls, technical problem resolution, and new product introduction activities.
* Working knowledge of quality management systems, regulatory compliance, product conformity, corrective action processes, and applicable manufacturing standards.
* Proven ability to develop and execute operational strategies, establish performance objectives, and achieve measurable improvements in quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience utilizing financial metrics, cost management practices, capital planning processes, and profitability analysis to drive operational decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable cross-functional management teams while promoting collaboration and organizational effectiveness.
* Experience applying Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and structured problem-solving methodologies to complex operational challenges.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and decision-making skills, with the ability to evaluate competing priorities, manage operational risks, and resolve complex business issues.
* Advanced proficiency with business and manufacturing information systems, including ERP/MRP platforms, Microsoft Office applications, and data analysis and reporting tools. Demonstrated ability to interpret operational and financial data, evaluate performance trends, and leverage technology to support strategic planning and informed decision-making.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with employees, senior leadership, customers, and external stakeholders.
* Ability to manage sensitive business information, exercise sound judgment, and maintain confidentiality in accordance with company and applicable security requirements.
* Ability to read, write, speak, and comprehend English sufficiently to interpret technical documentation, communicate operational requirements, and perform essential job responsibilities.
* Ability to work full-time on-site at the assigned company facility in Logan, UT.

**Security Clearance Requirement**

Candidates must possess current, verifiable eligibility for a U.S. Government Secret-level security clearance or be willing and able to complete the necessary documentation to initiate the company-sponsored clearance process within 60 days of hire. The ability to obtain and maintain the required security clearance eligibility is a continuing condition of employment. Employment may continue while an appropriately initiated clearance application is pending, subject to company authorization and applicable security restrictions. A final determination of ineligibility, denial, or loss of required clearance eligibility will result in disqualification from the position and may result in termination of employment, subject to applicable law and company policy.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Leadership experience within electronics manufacturing services (EMS), printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), or high-mix, low-volume manufacturing environments.
* Experience with surface mount technology (SMT), through-hole assembly, electromechanical assembly, manufacturing test, and related electronics manufacturing processes.
* Experience supporting aerospace, defense, medical device, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Familiarity with AS9100, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, applicable IPC standards, and customer-specific quality requirements.
* Knowledge of ITAR, controlled technical information, and security requirements applicable to defense-related manufacturing.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or other recognized continuous improvement credentials.
* APICS/ASCM certification, such as CPIM or CSCP, or equivalent supply chain management credentials.
* Experience leading operational transformations, facility expansions, production transfers, or significant manufacturing improvement initiatives.
* Experience utilizing business intelligence platforms, advanced reporting tools, and integrated manufacturing systems to monitor operational performance and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated success managing complex customer relationships, operational escalations, and cross-functional business challenges.

**Key Metrics and Focus Areas**

* Workplace safety performance and regulatory compliance.
* On-time delivery performance and production schedule attainment.
* Manufacturing efficiency, throughput, and capacity utilization.
* Product quality, first-pass yield, and cost of poor quality.
* Inventory accuracy, material availability, and inventory turns.
* Supplier delivery, quality, and overall performance.
* Operating cost performance, budget adherence, and profitability.
* Engineering responsiveness, manufacturing readiness, and successful new product introductions.
* Program execution support and fulfillment of customer commitments.
* Continuous improvement results, waste reduction, and operational efficiency.
* Quality management system effectiveness, audit performance, and corrective action closure.
* Workforce productivity, employee development, retention, and leadership effectiveness.
* Operational risk management, business continuity, and capacity readiness.

**Why This Role Matters**

As **Director of Operations,** you will play a critical role in shaping the performance, operational capabilities, and continued growth of our North Logan manufacturing facility. Your leadership will directly influence how effectively we deliver complex, high-reliability electronic products to customers operating in some of the world's most demanding industries. This is an opportunity to lead talented teams, strengthen operational performance, implement meaningful improvements, and contribute to the long-term success of a growing manufacturing organization.

**Benefits – Why Join Spartronics?**

At Spartronics, we recognize that our employees are essential to our success. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, financial well-being, and professional development of our team members.

Benefits may include:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) retirement savings plan.
* Paid time off and company-paid holidays.
* Company-paid life insurance and disability benefits.
* Employee assistance and wellness resources.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Opportunities to contribute to innovative products supporting mission-critical industries.

*Specific benefits and eligibility are subject to applicable plan documents and company policies.*

**Physical Requirements and Work Location**

* Ability to work in both office and manufacturing environments, including regular movement throughout production, warehouse, and operational areas.
* Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods, with occasional bending and reaching.
* Ability to occasionally lift, carry, or move materials weighing up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to operate computers and standard office equipment.
* Ability to wear required personal protective equipment when entering designated manufacturing areas.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Work Authorization & ITAR Requirements**

Due to the nature of certain products, technologies, and customer requirements, this position may involve access to export-controlled technical data or defense-related information subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and other applicable export control laws. Candidates must meet applicable U.S. export control authorization requirements and be eligible to access controlled technical information as required by the position. For this position, additional U.S. Government security clearance eligibility requirements apply, as described above.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

*Spartronics is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veteran/Disabled 41 CFR 60-1.4. We comply with federal Affirmative Action guidelines in all employment opportunities for qualified employees and applicants.Employment at Spartronics is considered at-will, meaning that either the employee or Spartronics may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause, and with or without prior notification.*

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. **View the SENS Product Catalog**
